controls.title: Controls
controls.idleHint: Click a key slot to rebind
controls.captureHint: Press any key, Esc to cancel, Backspace to clear

first_catch.description: Speak with the Fisherman, then catch your first fish.

travellers_errand.description: Talk to the Traveller, then report to the Guard.

heed_the_warning.description: Talk to the Guard, survive for 60 seconds in the danger zone, then return to the Guard.

anti_death_measures.description: Talk to the Merchant, harvest yekberries, then return to the Merchant.

placeholder_main_quest_3.description: A new chapter opens once your parallel errands are complete.

rod.openInventory: To equip your new rod, open your inventory (press {key} on desktop).
rod.openInventoryMobile: To equip your new rod, tap the inventory button.
rod.selectRod: Click your rod in the inventory to select it.
rod.equipRod: Click the rod equipment slot on the right to equip it.
rod.closeInventoryMobile: Tap the inventory button again to close your inventory.

fishing.useRod: You're near water. Press {key} (desktop) or click the rod button to start fishing.
fishing.holdCast: Hold the cast button for a few seconds, then release.
fishing.reel: Click the reel button repeatedly until you catch the fish.
fishing.stop: Great catch! Click Stop Fishing, then talk to the Fisherman.

food.openInventoryMobile: Open your inventory to get your berry ready.
food.selectBerry: Click the yekberries in your inventory.
food.explainScore: That red +20 is the food score. In this basic form, yekberries only heal about 1 out of 5 uses.
food.equipQuickslot1: Move the yekberries into quick slot 1 on the right.
food.closeInventoryMobile: Close your inventory to try the quick slot.
food.stabHeartLoss: STAB! You just lost a heart! Now we'll use the berry to heal up.
food.consumeQuickslot1: Now click quick slot 1 to eat. This tutorial forces a heal so you can see it, but +20 food score normally means about a 1/5 chance.

interaction.useInteract: Use this interact button for most world and character interactions.

greeting.0: Hey! Nice timing, I was just polishing my knife.

choice.askRod: Can I get a fishing rod?

hasRod.0: Good to see you already geared up. Go reel in something sharp!

noRod.0: Well hello there! You look unarmed. Take this fishing rod.

hasRod.0: Hey now... I ALREADY GAVE YOU A ROD! NOW SCRAM!!!

noRod.0: Ugh, fine. But you better not mess up my fishing spot!

greeting.0: Tides are honest. Keep your blade sharp, and your heart sharper.
Stay sharp. Anchor Hollow is peaceful, but peace is work.

preUnlock.0: It's not safe out here... GET BACK TO TOWN!

bridgeBlocked.0: HOLD YOUR HORSES! Who said you could cross this bridge?

intro.0: WOAH! Where do you think you're going??
intro.1: Well, what do you think is over there? A fancy hotel? Look kid, you aren't ready for what's across this bridge
intro.3: Okay fine. If you're really so tough, cross this bridge, and stay a while. Let's say... 60 seconds. Sound good?

choice.exploring: Uhhh... I'm just exploring I guess?

wait.0: Cross this bridge, survive 60 seconds in the danger zone, then report back to me.

return.0: WHAT?? How did you survive that???
return.1: Well, color me impressed. Not many in our town could survive out there...
return.2: Tell you what, If you gear up right, and show me that you're ready, I'll help you learn how to fight these evil beasts.
return.3: Don't worry, you'll know when you are ready. Until then, good luck.

post.0: Come back when you are ready... you're not quite there yet.

greeting.0: Easy now. The fish bite when the water is calm and the hands are patient.
If your pack feels light, my stall can fix that.

intro.1: Then let's start with money. You got any?
intro.3: How are you even surviving in Anchor Hollow?
intro.4: I'm new here. Still figuring things out.
intro.5: Alright, I'll help. Find a nearby Yekbush and grab some yekberries for a barely nourishing meal.
intro.6: Bring them back to me when you've harvested one.

harvest.0: Find a nearby Yekbush and gather some yekberries. Barely nourishing, but enough to keep you alive.
harvest.1: Come back once you've picked a bush and we'll call you battle-ready.

return.0: Good haul. Those yekberries keep fighters standing.
return.1: For now. Soon I'll teach you how to turn yekfruits into a more nourishing meal.
return.2: Keep a few slotted and use them before panic takes over.

player.0: So this is just... survival food?

greeting.0: A quiet mind hears what loud waves hide.

goldenberries.description: A rare, sweet berry that restores vitality.

yekberries.name: Yek Berries
yekberries.description: Tart berries from a yekbush. Simple, reliable healing food.

fat_cod.description: An oversized cod, quite the catch!

fat_salmon.name: Fat Salmon

apple_core.description: The remains of someone's snack. Very fresh, oddly.

trash_bag.description: A soggy trash bag. Who throws these in the water?

sea_pickle.name: Sea Pickle
sea_pickle.description: A bioluminescent sea pickle. Kinda cute, actually.

broken_specs.description: Someone's lost glasses. They probably can't read now.

infested_boot.description: An old boot now home to mysterious sea creatures.

infested_vase.name: Infested Vase
infested_vase.description: An ancient vase covered in barnacles. Could be valuable!

ruined_chest.name: Ruined Chest
ruined_chest.description: A waterlogged treasure chest. Most contents have rotted away.
